svg.title: TuneTune: from an idea to a model you can try
svg.desc: One person describes the task, reviews the plan and subjective references, changes scope when needed, and tries results. The Agent researches, prepares tests and a baseline, runs experiment rounds, and verifies local models. The workbench supports every stage. Test problems return to evaluation; trial feedback returns to experiments.

g.text: From an idea to a model you can try
Set up the study; look into methods
Check the test, then measure a baseline
Compare results; decide what to try
Run final checks; verify local use
Test issue? Revise and compare again
Review plans, experiments and results, check reference answers, and try models. Continue from saved work.
Finish at the goal, budget limit, or when no worthwhile next step remains
